name: wasd-keyboard-repeat
title: WASD Tweak
description: Turns off Windows Filter Keys if enabled and sets fast key repeat. Can help if Windows accessibility filtering is delaying your keystrokes.
deepDescription:
WHAT IT CHANGES
Turns off the Windows Filter Keys accessibility feature only if it is currently enabled, then sets your Windows keyboard repeat delay and speed to their fastest settings. This can help if Filter Keys was delaying or ignoring key presses.

FIVEM / GAMES
This is a Windows input setting, not a FiveM modification. It does not create movement glitches, change hit registration, bypass game rules, or increase keyboard hardware polling rate. Most games read held movement keys directly, so faster key repeat mainly affects text fields.

UNDO
Your original Filter Keys state and keyboard repeat values are saved before the change and restored by Undo.
